summary: Completed testing of drag-and-drop episode reordering feature. Backend API (POST /api/creator/series/{id}/reorder-episodes) works correctly - verified via curl. Frontend drag-and-drop using @dnd-kit library is fully functional with visual feedback during drag, success toast notification, and episode code updates after reorder.

minor.issue: Blocks automated requests with 'Automated requests are not allowed' error when called from pytest. Manual curl requests work fine.

ui_bugs.note: Functional but causes React hydration warning
